proposed_edges.relationship: Geary participated in the source-based electronic debate published as ‘Qui a peur de l'an mil ?’ (1999), coordinated and edited into published form by Barbara H. Rosenwein.
proposed_edges.evidence_note: Primary editorial preamble read, printed p. 15, first two paragraphs: four discussants are named, including Geary; Rosenwein ‘a assuré la mise en scène et la mise en forme’. The exchange occurred in January–February 1998 and appeared in 1999. Later pages remain unread. This records a published collaborative exchange, without imputing shared conclusions or treating Rosenwein as one of the four discussants.

proposed_edges.relationship: Geary and R. Bin Wong coauthored Societies and Cultures in World History (1994 in Geary's CV), alongside Mark Kishlansky and Patricia O'Brien.
proposed_edges.evidence_note: Geary's institutional CV, printed p. 4, Books and monographs: the textbook is listed ‘with Mark Kishlansky, Patricia O'Brien, and Bin Wong’, followed by HarperCollins and 1994. Bibliographic authorship only; textbook body unread and individual arguments unattributed. An indexed publisher advertisement markets a 1995 edition, but its PDF could not be read. The first-publication date discrepancy remains unresolved; 1994 is explicitly the CV's date.
